### 2026-10-24 – Ok so what happened is that I can't access the guide as GitHub is blocked and not working. So I cmnd A'd it from my Mac and sent it to myself via email. Now, I can continue. I honestly have never enjo

**11h**

Ok so what happened is that I can't access the guide as GitHub is blocked and not working. So I cmnd A'd it from my Mac and sent it to myself via email. Now, I can continue. I honestly have never enjoyed wokring with sound as a topic, even though I love music, but yeah. So, back to my project.

I have made great progress as the images tell you!

Things I am using:
EC11 Rotary Encoders
SK6812 MINI-E Neopixels
Bourns Slide Potentiometers
Kailh Choc Low-Profile Switches
 Waveshare ESP32-S3-Zero

MAJOR DRAWBACK!! I normally don't take till the Saturday to submit, but my KiCAD was BROKEN and ACTING UP. So I still managed to get some stuff done, but during the glitches I took screenshots to draw on and make better. Hope it's all good.
